For each Id in the test set, you must predict the value of the SalePrice variable. \n\n### Metric\n\nSubmissions are evaluated on [Root-Mean-Squared-Error (RMSE)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Root-mean-square_deviation) between the logarithm of the predicted value and the logarithm of the observed sales price. succeed in this competition and others like it.\n\n### Other R Tutorials\n\n**[Fun with Real Estate
